lines.zh: 巨化的身体，每一步都踩塌。
lines.en: Giant body. Every step collapses something.

lines.zh: 十二格高，云在肩膀旁边。
lines.en: Twelve blocks tall. The clouds sit at my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚底离地很高。
lines.en: I drift. My feet hang far above the ground.
My shadow covers an entire forest.
Trees at my feet. Like grass.

lines.zh: 这一带的风被我一推就歪了。
lines.en: One sweep of my arm bends the wind.
When I turn, mountains ought to move.

lines.zh: 我慢慢飘，因为快起来会毁掉一切。
lines.en: I drift slowly. Speed would destroy everything.
My skin glows green in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 你们跑再远，也在我一步里。
lines.en: Run as you like. You're still within one step.

lines.zh: 我抬着头，云在头顶散开。
lines.en: Head raised. The clouds part around me.

lines.zh: 巨化之后，说话的声音太响。
lines.en: Enlarged like this, my voice is too loud.

lines.zh: 我吸一口气，风都往这边来。
lines.en: I breathe in. The wind comes with it.
This body blocks out the sky.

lines.zh: 我低头看村庄，像看模型。
lines.en: I look down at a village. Like a model.

lines.zh: 气在体内比原来浓十倍。
lines.en: The energy inside me is ten times thicker.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，鸟从我肩上落下。
lines.en: I stay still. Birds settle on my shoulder.
Energy circles slowly at my joints.
The shadow stays because I stay.

lines.zh: 我在听地面上的声音，很小。
lines.en: Listening to the ground. So faint.

lines.zh: 巨化是一种选择，不是失控。
lines.en: Growing like this is a choice. Not a loss of control.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，五指遮住太阳。
lines.en: I raise a hand. Five fingers cover the sun.
My wrinkles are stretched flat now.
Quiet here but for the wind.

lines.zh: 我站的地方，地面在下沉。
lines.en: The ground is sinking where I stand.
Look up. Don't be scared by the shadow.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里，只有一个指甲大。
lines.en: You're a fingernail's width to me.
I have to squint to find you.
You don't reach my ankle.

lines.zh: 你的箭飞上来，够不到我的脸。
lines.en: Your arrows fly up. They don't reach my face.
Craning up that long will hurt your neck.

lines.zh: 你一喊，声音就被风吹散。
lines.en: Your shout is scattered by the wind.

lines.zh: 我低头，影子整个压住你。
lines.en: I lower my head and my shadow swallows you.

lines.zh: 你在发抖，我感觉得到地面。
lines.en: You're shaking. I feel it through the ground.

lines.zh: 巨化的眼睛，看得很清楚。
lines.en: Giant eyes. I see you perfectly.

lines.zh: 我不用动手，光站着就够。
lines.en: I needn't move. Standing is enough.

lines.zh: 你退，退到哪儿都在我影子里。
lines.en: Retreat. You're in my shadow anywhere.

lines.zh: 我想听你说一句话，太小。
lines.en: I'd like to hear you. Too small.
That felt like a mosquito bite.
Being this big isn't being invincible.
I look down to find where it hurts.
A hairline split in my skin.
My aura wavered. It steadied.
You do dare.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，树倒了一片。
lines.en: I stepped back. A stand of trees fell.
A clear pain. It's been a while.
I won't cry out. That would be undignified.
This body still holds.
Six times my size; my steps sound like thunder.
Eat that? Amusing.

lines.zh: 巨化的身体不需要进食。
lines.en: A body this size has no need to eat.
Hold it higher. Maybe then I'll see it.

lines.zh: 你的好意，我收下了，东西丢了吧。
lines.en: I accept the gesture. Keep the item.

lines.zh: 这气味被风一吹就没了。
lines.en: The wind takes that smell away.
I lean down to see what's in your hand.
A single grain. It wouldn't fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 你要用这个喂我？站着别动。
lines.en: You'd feed me with that? Stand still.
Leave it. I won't reach down.
You hit me like hitting a mountain.
I lift a foot. You're beneath it.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我只是地面在晃。
lines.en: To me a collision is just the ground shaking.

lines.zh: 别靠近脚边，那里看不见。
lines.en: Stay away from my feet. I can't see there.

lines.zh: 我挪半步，你就得跑十步。
lines.en: Half a step from me is ten from you.
You touched a toe.

lines.zh: 巨化的身体，让路很费劲。
lines.en: A body this size has trouble yielding.
I step back and every tree goes down.

lines.zh: 你在我的影子边缘盘旋。
lines.en: You circle at the edge of my shadow.

lines.zh: 这声闷响，隔着云都听见。
lines.en: A dull boom. Heard even above the clouds.
Everything is farther away now.
My kind is long gone.

lines.zh: 我这副身躯，不适合靠近。
lines.en: This body isn't made for closeness.

lines.zh: 你站在下面，我们就隔着云。
lines.en: You down there, me up here. Clouds between.

lines.zh: 不必了，剩下的日子不多。
lines.en: No need. Few years remain.

lines.zh: 我低头，能看见你的头顶。
lines.en: I look down and see the top of your head.
Don't mistake my words for gentleness.

lines.zh: 我伸手，你就会被风卷走。
lines.en: If I reach out, the wind takes you.

lines.zh: 退远些，这样我能看见你。
lines.en: Go farther. Then I can see you.

lines.zh: 巨化的孤独，比原来更重。
lines.en: A giant's solitude is heavier than before.
Two fingers is all it takes.
Can't see. Up to my eye.

lines.zh: 这东西在我手里像沙粒。
lines.en: Like a grain of sand in my hand.

lines.zh: 地上的小玩意儿，值得一看。
lines.en: A little trinket on the ground. Worth a look.
I squeezed too hard. It broke.
Up to the sun. Light passes through.
I set it in the middle of my palm.
A small thing. No use.
I put it back. Not worth carrying.

lines.zh: 它落地的声音，我听得见。
lines.en: I hear it hit the ground.

lines.zh: 我从云上看见你抬头了。
lines.en: I saw you look up from the clouds.
My gaze just fell on you.
Enlarged, locking on is faster.
Run. One step reaches you.
Energy leaks between my fingers.
A small matter. No need for full strength.
Your energy is a lamp to me.

lines.zh: 别往林子里跑，树挡不住。
lines.en: Not into the trees. They won't stop me.
I raise my hand to cloud height.
My shadow has closed in.
These giant eyes only track movement.
I know exactly where you are.
Now. One minute is enough.
Look up. Don't blink.
I bend down. The clouds push aside.
This hand is bigger than a house.

lines.zh: 你跑到山后，我也看得见。
lines.en: Run behind the hill. I'll still see you.
You're at the center of my shadow.
No rush. Giants have time.
The ground under my feet warms.
Everything of yours is too small.
Energy gathers at my fingertip.

lines.zh: 抬头，你会看见一片巴掌。
lines.en: Look up. You'll see a palm.
My breath bends the trees.
Keep backing and you'll fall off the slope.

lines.zh: 巨人的耐心也是有限的。
lines.en: Even a giant's patience ends.
I've marked this whole area.
My foot is up, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，云就被推开了。
lines.en: I lift a hand and the clouds part.
Now. This instant.

lines.zh: 一掌下来，地面裂成两半。
lines.en: One palm and the ground splits in two.
My foot comes down. The crater's deeper than you.
Fingers sweep. A row of trees snaps.
The shockwave throws you into the air.

lines.zh: 巨化的拳头不需要准头。
lines.en: A giant's fist doesn't need accuracy.
One swing and part of the hillside is gone.

lines.zh: 你挡的那下，震得你手麻。
lines.en: You blocked it. Your arms went numb.
One palm covers the whole street.

lines.zh: 这一声，整个谷都听得见。
lines.en: The whole valley heard that.
Another blow and the terrain changes.
I raise my hand. The wind arrives first.
I feel your bones through my palm.
Dodge? Not at this distance.
Not done. Give me room.
I descend out of the clouds.

lines.zh: 巨化的一刻，山震了一下。
lines.en: The moment I grew, the mountain shook.
Twelve blocks tall. My head is in the clouds.

lines.zh: 脚下的一切突然变很小。
lines.en: Everything below suddenly became tiny.
I land. The crater is half a village wide.

lines.zh: 地面沉了一层，那就是我。
lines.en: The ground dropped a layer. That's me.

lines.zh: 鸟群惊起，因为我挡住了太阳。
lines.en: Birds burst up. I've blocked the sun.

lines.zh: 我在半空停下，慢慢变大。
lines.en: I halt midair and grow, slowly.

lines.zh: 这里没有够我站的地方。
lines.en: Nowhere here is big enough for me to stand.

lines.zh: 我出现的样子，像天塌了一块。
lines.en: I arrive like a piece of sky falling.
The wind circles me once.

lines.zh: 我从山上过来，树全倒了。
lines.en: I came over the mountain. Every tree went down.
This big, and you still stand there.
My aura pushes the clouds apart.

lines.zh: 我张开手，能握住一座塔。
lines.en: I spread my hand. It could hold a tower.

lines.zh: 这一片已经不属于你们。
lines.en: This land no longer belongs to you.
I lower my head and the sky goes dark.

lines.zh: 巨化的代价，我早付过了。
lines.en: I paid the price of growing long ago.

lines.zh: 从远处看，我像一根柱子。
lines.en: From far away I look like a pillar.

lines.zh: 终于，有值得俯视的东西了。
lines.en: At last, something worth looking down on.

lines.zh: 火焰在我皮肤上爬，像小虫。
lines.en: Fire crawls my skin like insects.

lines.zh: 从云上落下来，砸出了湖。
lines.en: Fell from the clouds and made a lake.

lines.zh: 水没到我腰，气就堵住了。
lines.en: Water at my waist. My energy chokes.
The blast bloomed in my palm.
A pinprick, stuck in the hide.
This power ignores size.

lines.zh: 巨化耗气，我撑不了太久。
lines.en: This size burns energy. I can't last.

lines.zh: 天雷劈在我肩上，半个身体发麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck my shoulder. Half of me went numb.

lines.zh: 这么大，也会一直往下掉。
lines.en: Even this big, I keep falling.
